# Phase 3 contract (internal, for parallel implementation)

Same rules as CONTRACT.md: iOS 18 target, Swift 5 mode, compiled on GitHub Actions (Xcode 16.x on macos-15-intel; also keep Xcode 26 compatible), nobody can compile locally. Edit only your own files; grep before declaring a top-level type. Japanese UI strings. App display name is now "Video Mania".

## Shared model (already written — read, do NOT edit)
- `Sources/Model/Phase3Models.swift`: NormalizedPoint, TransitionType/ClipTransition, ClipAnimationType/ClipAnimation, ClipGeometry, SpeedPoint/SpeedCurve (speed(at:), outputDuration(trimmed:), segments(count:), presets), MarkerKind/TimelineMarker, KeyframeEasing/Keyframe/KeyframeInterpolator, TextAnimationType, TextAlignment2, TextShadow, TextStyle, TextTemplate, TextClip (isSticker), DrawingStroke/DrawingClip, SubtitleWord, CaptionTemplate, WatermarkCorner/WatermarkSettings, VoicePreset/AudioEffects, HSLBand/HSLAdjustment, FormatKind/FormatBlock, MemoPaper/CoverSettings, ExportPreset, Color(hex:)/UIColor(hex:)/UIColor.hexString.
- `Sources/Model/Models.swift` additions: `Clip.transition`, `.animation`, `.geometry`, `.speedCurve` (outputDuration honours it), `.isReversed` + `.reversedURL`, `.stillImageURL` (+ `isStill`); `FilterSettings.hsl`, `.lutFileName`, `.lutIntensity`; `SubtitleStyle.template`, `.highlightColorHex`, `.fontName` (defaults now cinema: 0.038, no background); `SubtitleCue.words`; `CanvasSettings.resolution` default `.uhd4k`; `ProjectSnapshot`/`EditorProject` new arrays `textClips`, `drawings`, `markers`, plus `watermark: WatermarkSettings`, `cover: CoverSettings` (memberwise init order: clips, subtitles, subtitleStyle, audio, canvas, documentary, titleCards, lowerThirds, overlays, narration, textClips, drawings, markers, watermark, cover); helpers textClipBinding/removeTextClip/sortTextClips, drawingBinding/removeDrawing, markerBinding/removeMarker/sortMarkers, chapterListText(), clipTimelineStart(id:).
- `Sources/Model/AudioTrackModels.swift`: `ClipAudioSettings.effects: AudioEffects`, `NarrationClip.effects: AudioEffects`.
- `Sources/Model/OverlayModels.swift`: `OverlayClip.keyframes: [Keyframe]`, `.blendMode: String?` (CIFilter name like "CIMultiplyBlendMode", "CIScreenBlendMode", "CIOverlayBlendMode", "CISoftLightBlendMode", "CILightenBlendMode"; nil = source over).
- `Sources/Model/EditorSelection.swift`: new cases `.text(UUID)`, `.drawing(UUID)`, `.marker(UUID)` with textID/drawingID/markerID. EditorSelection now has 8 cases.
- `DocumentaryStyle` defaults are now the recommended documentary look (user choice), autoDucking false.

## Partitions and the APIs they must provide

### V — Engine video (files: CompositionBuilder.swift, VideoCompositor.swift, OverlayRenderer.swift, FilterEngine.swift, FilterLUT.swift, DocumentaryRenderer.swift; new: TextRenderer.swift, TransitionRenderer.swift, GeometryMath.swift)
- Transitions: clip N's `transition` overlaps clip N and N+1 by `duration` (clamped to ≤ half of each clip's output length). Total duration shrinks accordingly. Implement with two alternating video tracks (A/B) so both frames are available; instruction for the overlap carries both track IDs and the type; TransitionRenderer blends (dissolve, fade via black/white, slides, zooms, wipes, blur). Expose `static func CompositionBuilder.timelineLayout(for snapshot: ProjectSnapshot) -> [ClipPlacement]` with `struct ClipPlacement { let clipID: UUID; let start: Double; let end: Double }` (output seconds AFTER overlaps) and make `EditorProject.clipStartTimes()`-based UI tolerate the difference (UI/timeline use `timelineLayout` when drawing). Also `static func totalDuration(for:) -> Double`.
- Clip animations (in/out) applied to the clip image before compositing: fade, slides, zooms, blur, spin.
- Geometry: rotation quarter turns, flips, crop (NormalizedRect in rotated space), zoom/offset, applied before canvas fit.
- Speed curve: when `clip.speedCurve.enabled`, insert the trimmed source range as N segments (`speedCurve.segments()`) each scaled by its speed; audio segments the same; `smoothSlow` → in the compositor blend the current frame with the previous one (keep last frame per track) by 50% when the local speed < 1 (frame blending).
- Still clips (`stillImageURL != nil`): no video source; instruction has empty requiredSourceTrackIDs; compositor draws the image (cached) with geometry + Ken Burns-like gentle zoom if `animation` says zoomIn. Audio: none. Timeline length = outputDuration (endTime−startTime; still clips get `duration` 3600 at creation and endTime = desired seconds).
- Reversed clips: when `isReversed && reversedURL != nil`, use reversedURL as the source (its timeline is already reversed; source range maps to (duration−endTime, duration−startTime)).
- Text layers (`snapshot.textClips`) and stickers: TextRenderer renders TextClip to CIImage (cached by content+style+size; UIGraphicsImageRenderer; supports stroke via NSAttributedString strokeWidth negative, shadow, background box with padding/corner, alignment, letterSpacing (kern), lineSpacing, vertical (`NSAttributedString` with verticalGlyphForm or draw per character stacked), curveRadius (draw glyphs along an arc), custom fontName if registered). Animations in/out: fade, typewriter (clip to progressive character count), pop (scale overshoot), slideUp/Left, blurIn, scaleDown, wordByWord. Keyframes via KeyframeInterpolator (center/scale/rotation/opacity relative to start). Templates (TextTemplate) are style presets — expose `static func TextStyle.preset(_ t: TextTemplate) -> TextStyle` in TextRenderer.swift as an extension.
- Drawings: render strokes (Catmull-Rom smoothed polyline) with reveal animation.
- Subtitle templates: SubtitleRenderer (you may edit it too — it's yours in this phase) renders by `style.template`: karaoke (words up to current time in highlightColor), boxPop (current word in a colored rounded box), outlineBig, pillHighlight, typewriter; uses `style.fontName` when set. Falls back to plain when `cue.words` is empty.
- Watermark: `snapshot.watermark` image or text at corner with opacity/size, drawn after everything (before letterbox? after — it stays visible).
- Filters: `FilterSettings.hsl` → build a 3D LUT per HSLAdjustment (cache by value) applying per-band hue/sat/lum with smooth band weights; `lutFileName` → `.cube` parser in FilterLUT (`static func loadCube(url:) throws -> (size: Int, data: Data)`; cache) applied with `lutIntensity` after preset; `FilterEngine.autoEnhance(_ image: CIImage) -> CIImage` using `image.autoAdjustmentFilters(options: [.enhance: true, .redEye: false])`; `FilterEngine.suggestedAdjustments(toMatch reference: UIImage, from source: UIImage) -> ColorAdjustments` (compare mean luminance/saturation/temperature of both and return brightness/saturation/temperature deltas); `FilterEngine.autoEnhanceAdjustments(for image: UIImage) -> ColorAdjustments` (approximate by measuring mean/contrast).
- Scopes: `enum ScopeAnalyzer { static func luminanceHistogram(_ image: CGImage, bins: Int = 64) -> [Float]; static func waveform(_ image: CGImage, columns: Int = 64, rows: Int = 32) -> [[Float]]; static func rgbMeans(_ image: CGImage) -> (r: Float, g: Float, b: Float) }` (CIAreaHistogram or manual sampling on a downscaled bitmap).
- Keep all existing public signatures.

### A — Engine audio & media tools (new files: AudioEffectsRenderer.swift, BeatDetector.swift, TextToSpeech.swift, MediaTools.swift, ColorMatch is in V; edit: CompositionBuilder audio use is V's — so A exposes processed URLs and V's builder calls `AudioEffectsRenderer.cachedProcessedURL(for: url, range:, effects:)` synchronously if available)
- `enum AudioEffectsRenderer`: `static func processedURL(for url: URL, effects: AudioEffects) async throws -> URL` renders the WHOLE file once through AVAudioEngine manual rendering (AVAudioUnitEQ 3 bands, AVAudioUnitTimePitch pitch, voice presets = combinations incl. distortion/reverb/bandpass for radio/telephone, noise reduction = high-pass 120 Hz + simple gate) to an m4a in Caches/ProcessedAudio keyed by hash(url + effects); `static func cachedProcessedURL(for url: URL, effects: AudioEffects) -> URL?` sync lookup; `static func clearCache()`. CompositionBuilder (partition V) uses the cached URL when `!effects.isIdentity` and the UI triggers processing (await) before the player rebuild.
- `enum BeatDetector { static func detectBeats(url: URL, start: Double, end: Double, sensitivity: Double = 0.5) async throws -> [Double] }` (spectral-flux/energy onset detection on the envelope; returns source seconds; also `static func estimateBPM(onsets: [Double]) -> Double?`).
- `enum TextToSpeech { static func availableVoices(language: String) -> [(id: String, name: String)]; static func render(text: String, voiceIdentifier: String?, rate: Float, pitch: Float) async throws -> URL }` using AVSpeechSynthesizer.write(_:toBufferCallback:) into an AVAudioFile (m4a or caf) in MediaStore.mediaDirectory; returns URL and the UI makes a NarrationClip (duration via AVURLAsset).
- `enum MediaTools`: `static func extractAudio(from url: URL, start: Double?, end: Double?) async throws -> URL` (m4a via AVAssetExportSession AppleM4A); `static func reversedCopy(of url: URL, start: Double, end: Double, progress: ((Double) -> Void)?) async throws -> URL` (AVAssetReader frames into memory in chunks of ≤ 60 frames reversed → AVAssetWriter; audio reversed too by reading PCM and reversing sample order; cancellable); `static func freezeFrameImage(from url: URL, at seconds: Double) async throws -> URL` (JPEG in mediaDirectory, oriented); `static func importFont(from url: URL) throws -> String` (copies .ttf/.otf into mediaDirectory/Fonts and registers with CTFontManagerRegisterFontsForURL, returns PostScript name) and `static func registerStoredFonts()` (call at launch; also expose `static func storedFontNames() -> [String]`); `static func importLUT(from url: URL) throws -> String` (copies .cube into mediaDirectory/LUTs; returns file name) and `static func storedLUTNames() -> [String]`.
- `enum GIFExporter { static func export(snapshot: ProjectSnapshot, start: Double, end: Double, fps: Int = 12, maxWidth: CGFloat = 480, progress: ((Double) -> Void)?) async throws -> URL }` renders frames via AVAssetImageGenerator on the built composition (CompositionBuilder.build(..., purpose: .export) then AVAssetImageGenerator with videoComposition) into an animated GIF with ImageIO.
- `enum CoverRenderer { static func render(snapshot: ProjectSnapshot, cover: CoverSettings, size: CGSize) async throws -> UIImage }` (background = frame at cover.frameTime from the built composition or cover.imageURL; memo card with MemoPaper colors, slight rotation, handwritten-ish font if available else rounded system font, title at top-left; returns image) and `static func saveToPhotos(_ image: UIImage) async throws`.
- Export additions in ExportManager.swift (A owns ExportManager this phase): `func startAudioOnly(snapshot:)` (m4a), `func startDual(snapshot:)` (sequential: landscape 16:9 then portrait 9:16 with scaling .fitBlur; both saved; state text shows 1/2, 2/2), `private(set) var history: [ExportRecord]` with `struct ExportRecord: Identifiable { id, url, date, duration, canvasDescription }` persisted in Documents/Exports/history.json (keep last 20; drop entries whose file is gone), `func deleteRecord(_:)`. Watermark is rendered by V inside the composition, nothing needed here.

### P — Persistence & stores (files: ProjectStore.swift; new: PresetStore.swift, FormatKitStore.swift, ProjectPackage.swift)
- ProjectStore: persist every new field (Clip transition/animation/geometry/speedCurve/isReversed/reversedURL/stillImageURL; FilterSettings hsl/lut; SubtitleStyle template/highlight/fontName; SubtitleCue.words; ClipAudioSettings.effects; NarrationClip.effects; OverlayClip.keyframes/blendMode; textClips; drawings; markers; watermark; cover) with optional decode defaults (old files load). Also `Codable` mirrors for CanvasSettings/SubtitleStyle/DocumentaryStyle as `StoredCanvas` etc. that PresetStore can reuse (make them `internal`, not private).
- `@Observable final class PresetStore { static let shared; private(set) var presets: [ExportPreset]; func save(name:, canvas:, subtitleStyle:, documentary:); func rename; func delete; func apply(_ preset: ExportPreset, to project: EditorProject) }` persisted in Documents/presets.json. Built-in presets provided as `static let builtIns: [ExportPreset]` (YouTube 4K30, ショート 9:16 1080p30 軽量, Instagram 4:5, 長尺 高画質).
- `@Observable final class FormatKitStore { static let shared; private(set) var blocks: [FormatBlock]; func add/update/delete; func captureFromProject(_ project: EditorProject, range: ClosedRange<Double>, kind: FormatKind, name: String) -> FormatBlock` (copies title cards and text clips in the range, times made relative; mediaURL = first clip's url if the range is within one still/video clip), `func insert(_ block: FormatBlock, into project: EditorProject, at timelineTime: Double)` (inserts a still/black clip of block.duration — a still clip with stillImageURL = generated black PNG via a helper `static func blackStillURL()` in MediaStore? NO: create it in FormatKitStore (Caches/black.png, 1920×1080) — plus titleCards/textClips shifted to the insertion time; sets the clip's transition to block.transitionOut), persisted in Documents/formats.json with built-in starters (シンプルなオープニング: 黒背景 + 章タイトル; クロージング: 「ご視聴ありがとうございました」; ディバイダー: 1.5 s black with centered text).
- `enum ProjectPackage { static func export(projectID: UUID, progress: ((Double) -> Void)?) async throws -> URL }` creates a folder package `<name>.videomania` in temporaryDirectory containing project.json (copied) + media/ (referenced files copied) + thumbnail.jpg, and `static func importPackage(from url: URL) async throws -> ProjectMeta` (security scoped read; copies media into mediaDirectory keeping names (uniqueDestination if conflict and rewrite names in json), creates a new project id, registers with ProjectLibrary.shared). Also an `Info.plist` entry is NOT needed (folder share works through ShareLink(item: URL)).

### T — Timeline (files: TimelineView.swift, TimelineTrackViews.swift, TimelineThumbnailCache.swift)
- Use `CompositionBuilder.timelineLayout(for:)` for clip positions (overlaps from transitions shorten the timeline). Draw a small transition badge (icon) between clips when `clip.transition.isActive`; tap it → selection = .clip(id) and opens nothing (UI handles).
- Text track (above subtitles): TextClip bars (teal) with text; stickers show the emoji; tap → .text(id); move/resize handles; keyframe diamonds drawn on the selected text/overlay bar at keyframe times.
- Drawing track items (small pen icon bars) tap → .drawing(id).
- Markers on the ruler: flags with name (chapter = orange, note = yellow, beat = tiny gray ticks); tap → .marker(id); drag to move (history).
- Still clips: thumbnail from the image; reversed clips show a ◀◀ badge; speed-curve clips show a curve icon; geometry-changed clips a crop icon.
- Keep `TimelineView.totalHeight` updated (may grow to ~300).

### U1 — Editor UI wiring (files: ContentView.swift, EditorToolbar.swift, EditorPanels.swift; new: ClipFXPanels.swift, TextPanels.swift, DrawingCanvasView.swift)
- Exhaustive handling of the 8 EditorSelection cases everywhere; selection reset when items vanish.
- Clip toolbar additions: 「トランジション」 panel (TransitionType chips + duration slider; 「全クリップに適用」), 「アニメーション」 (in/out type chips + durations), 「切り抜き/回転」 (rotate 90° buttons, flip H/V, zoom slider, offset via drag on a small preview or two sliders, crop aspect presets: 自由/1:1/4:5/9:16/16:9 + 「リセット」), 「速度カーブ」 (presets chips montage/hero/bullet/flashIn/flashOut + enable toggle + smoothSlow toggle + an editable graph: 5 draggable points on a Canvas), 「逆再生」 (runs MediaTools.reversedCopy with progress overlay; sets isReversed/reversedURL; toggle off keeps file), 「フリーズ」 (MediaTools.freezeFrameImage at playhead → inserts a still Clip after splitting at playhead: still clip = Clip(url: imageURL, duration: 3600, naturalSize: image size, preferredTransform: .identity, hasAudio: false, thumbnail:, name:) with stillImageURL set and endTime = 2), 「置き換え」 (PhotosPicker single video → replaces url/duration/naturalSize/transform/hasAudio keeping start/end clamped), 「音声効果」 panel (AudioEffects sliders eqLow/Mid/High, pitch, VoicePreset chips, noise reduction; on change debounce 0.6 s then `await AudioEffectsRenderer.processedURL(...)` with a small spinner before the player rebuild), 「ビート検出」 (BeatDetector on the clip → adds markers kind .beat; option 「ビートで分割」 splits the clip at beats), 「HSL」 panel (band picker + 3 sliders), 「LUT」 panel (list of MediaTools.storedLUTNames + fileImporter for .cube + intensity), 「自動補正」 (FilterEngine.autoEnhanceAdjustments on the clip thumbnail → sets adjustments), 「色合わせ」 (pick a reference clip from a horizontal thumbnail list → FilterEngine.suggestedAdjustments), 「スコープ」 (sheet showing ScopeAnalyzer histogram + waveform of the current frame; refresh button).
- Root toolbar additions: 「テキスト」 now adds a TextClip at playhead (選択後にテキストパネル), 「ステッカー」 (emoji grid → TextClip isSticker), 「手書き」 (DrawingCanvasView over the preview: pointer/finger draws strokes in normalized coords, color/width chips, 完了 adds DrawingClip at playhead), 「マーカー」 (adds marker at playhead; marker panel: name, kind, 「チャプター一覧をコピー」 via UIPasteboard + chapterListText()), 「透かし」 (WatermarkSettings panel: toggle, text or image via PhotosPicker image → MediaStore copy, corner, opacity, size), 「フォーマット」 (FormatKitStore: list blocks by kind with 「先頭に挿入」「末尾に挿入」「再生位置に挿入」, and 「今の範囲をフォーマットとして保存」 asking name/kind/range = selected clip or 0…playhead), 「読み上げ」 (TextToSpeech panel: text field, voice picker, rate; renders and inserts NarrationClip at playhead), 「音声抽出」 (PhotosPicker video → MediaTools.extractAudio → NarrationClip), 「サムネ」 (opens CoverMakerView from U2), 「比較」 (opens CompareView from U2).
- Text selection toolbar: 「テキスト編集」 (text, template chips → TextStyle.preset, font picker incl. MediaTools.storedFontNames + fileImporter for .ttf/.otf, size, colors (ColorPicker → hex), stroke, shadow, background, alignment, letter/line spacing, vertical, curve), 「アニメーション」 (in/out + durations), 「配置」 (drag on preview: implement a transparent overlay on PreviewView that lets the selected TextClip/OverlayClip be dragged/pinched/rotated — update center/scale/rotation live; history on gesture start), 「キーフレーム」 (add keyframe at playhead from current center/scale/rotation/opacity; list; delete; easing chips), 「複製」「削除」. Overlay selection gains 「キーフレーム」 and 「ブレンド」 (chips: 通常/乗算/スクリーン/オーバーレイ/ソフトライト/比較(明)).
- Drawing selection: 「色・太さ」, 「表示時間」, 「削除」. Marker selection: 「名前」, 「種類」, 「削除」.
- Right-handed layout: in EditorToolbar put the most-used items (分割, 削除, テキスト) nearest the right edge when the toolbar fits without scrolling; otherwise unchanged.
- Subtitle selection: 「テンプレート」 chips (CaptionTemplate) + highlight color + font picker (SubtitleStyle.template/highlightColorHex/fontName).

### U2 — Secondary screens (files: ExportView.swift, ProjectLibraryView.swift, SubtitleEditorView.swift; new: CoverMakerView.swift, CompareView.swift, PresetViews.swift)
- ExportView: preset bar (PresetStore built-ins + user presets; 「現在の設定を保存」), 「GIFで書き出し」 (range = whole or selected marker pair / start–end fields; progress; ShareLink), 「音声のみ書き出し」, 「縦横を同時に書き出し」 toggle (calls startDual), 「書き出し履歴」 list (ExportManager.history) with ShareLink and 「比較を開く」, chapter text copy button.
- CoverMakerView(project:): live preview (CoverRenderer.render at 1280 px wide, debounced), frame time slider with thumbnail scrub, photo picker alternative, title + memo text fields, paper chips, position (drag), width, rotation, font picker, 「写真に保存」 + ShareLink.
- CompareView(project:player:): pick a previous export (ExportManager.history) and compare against the current timeline: side-by-side or swipe-split (slider) of two AVPlayers kept in sync (seek both; play both), audio toggle (A/B/mute), loudness readout via LoudnessAnalyzer for both (async), and a 「前回の書き出し」 label with date.
- ProjectLibraryView: 「書き出し(.videomania)」 in the card menu → ProjectPackage.export → ShareLink; 「読み込み」 toolbar button → fileImporter (folders allowed: allowedContentTypes [.folder, .package, .item]) → ProjectPackage.importPackage.
- SubtitleEditorView: template chips (CaptionTemplate), highlight color, font picker; 「単語タイミングを作り直す」 (re-run transcription for words only is complex — instead distribute words evenly across the cue when `words` is empty: `SubtitleCue.words` generated by splitting text with NLTokenizer word units proportional to character count — put this helper in SubtitleEditorView as a static func and also call it after transcription in TranscriptionService? No: TranscriptionService is NOT in this phase; so U2 calls a helper `SubtitleWordTiming.distribute(cue:) -> [SubtitleWord]` that U2 defines in SubtitleEditorView.swift (internal) and applies on import/transcribe results via the existing onFinish paths).

## Integration order
V, A, P, T, U1, U2 run in parallel; then one reviewer per partition; then a cross-check agent reconciles names (especially: `CompositionBuilder.timelineLayout`, `TextStyle.preset`, `AudioEffectsRenderer.*`, `MediaTools.*`, `BeatDetector`, `TextToSpeech`, `GIFExporter`, `CoverRenderer`, `ScopeAnalyzer`, `PresetStore`, `FormatKitStore`, `ProjectPackage`, `ExportManager.history/startDual/startAudioOnly`, `CoverMakerView(project:)`, `CompareView(project:player:)`).
